data.one_liner: Create, combine and apply custom page transitions to routes with GoRouter and Navigator.
data.what_it_does: Provides an easy way to create, combine, and apply page transitions for GoRouter and standard Flutter navigators. It supports customizable transitions such as fade, slide, rotate, scale, size, and platform-specific defaults.
use_when: You are using GoRouter and want custom or combined page transitions easily.
You need to apply standard or custom transitions using a fluent syntax-sugar API.
You want to use transitions outside the router using Navigator.push with GoTransitionRoute.
avoid_when: You do not use GoRouter or standard navigation routes where this package applies.
You prefer writing custom TransitionBuilders manually from scratch without helper libraries.
strengths: Simplifies complex route transition configurations into single-line or chained syntax.
Compatible with both GoRouter pageBuilder and standard Navigator pushes.
Provides built-in modifiers like withFade, withScale, and directional modifiers.
weaknesses: Tied closely to GoRouter ecosystem conventions and dependencies.
Depends on specific GoRouter version ranges.
data.setup_notes: No special native configuration or build_runner is required.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: GoRouter is the core routing package itself, which can handle standard page transitions natively without extra helper packages.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: Auto_route offers robust declarative routing and deep-linking out of the box with its own built-in transition management.
